title: Account Executive (Key Accounts)
description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

Caribou is building the engagement infrastructure for the home care workforce and the agentic layer for home care operations. Our platform interfaces with office staff and front-line caregivers to facilitate meaningful recognition, stronger relationships, and operational efficiency.  Caribou was recently recognized as one of Canada's fastest-growing companies by both The Globe and Mail (#4 in technology) and Deloitte's Technology Fast 50™ – and we're just getting started! title: International CRM & Retention lead
description: Job description   Ready to take CRM and customer retention to the next level in online fashion? title: CRM Manager & HubSpot Consultant (w/m/d) | Teilzeit 20h
description:
Wir sind emerve, HubSpot Platinum Partner mit Fokus auf CRM, Marketing-Automatisierung und saubere Prozesse im B2B-Umfeld. Unser Ansatz: Wir schaffen keine Abhängigkeiten. Wir befähigen unsere Kund:innen, HubSpot und ihre CRM-Prozesse selbst zu verstehen und weiterzuentwickeln. Dokumentation, Schulungen und Erklärvideos gehören bei uns genauso zur Arbeit wie die Umsetzung.

Worum es in dieser Rolle wirklich geht
Du bist nicht die Person, die Tickets abarbeitet. Du bist die Person, bei der ein Kundenprojekt liegt: Du weißt, wo es steht, was als Nächstes passiert, wo es hakt, und du sprichst das an, bevor der Kunde fragt. Fachlich unterstützt dich das Team. Die Verantwortung für den Projektverlauf trägst du.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest eigene HubSpot-Kundenprojekte von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Übergabe: Scope, Zeitplan, Budget im Blick, Status an Kund:innen und intern.

  • Du planst Arbeitspakete, setzt Prioritäten und hältst Termine, auch wenn auf Kundenseite Zuarbeit fehlt. Dann klärst du das aktiv.

  • Du meldest Risiken früh: drohende Budgetüberschreitung, Scope-Änderungen, Blocker.

  • Du implementierst neue HubSpot-Instanzen und optimierst bestehende Setups: Datenstrukturen, Pipelines, Workflows, Formulare, Landing Pages, Integrationen.

  • Du berätst Kund:innen zu Marketing-, Sales- und CRM-Prozessen und erklärst Zusammenhänge verständlich.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit so, dass Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen ohne dich weiterarbeiten können.

Qualifikation

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1): Unsere Kund:innen sind überwiegend deutschsprachig. Du führst Workshops, schreibst Konzepte und verhandelst Scope auf Deutsch.

  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1): HubSpot, Dokumentationen, Partner und Teile unserer Kommunikation laufen auf Englisch.

title: Sales Team Lead
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Manager
description:
Your mission

Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, you own how customers on both sides activate, buy and stay. You decide which signals matter and what should happen next, and a Growth Engineer builds the system with you. You'll be one of the first hires in a lean marketing team and shape how it works as it grows. We're looking for someone ambitious: you think in systems that sense, decide and learn, not in a handful of fixed, old-school email journeys.

What you'll do

• Define the lifecycle and signal strategy for general contractors and subcontractors: the key stages and behaviours, and the signals that predict activation, repeat usage, expansion or churn.

• Turn those signals into playbooks: prioritized interventions, segments and messages, coordinated with Sales and Customer Success where a human touch works better.

• Drive subcontractor activation, conversion to Premium and churn prevention, and contractor adoption and retention, including 1:1 logic on enriched account data.

• Prove what works with cohort baselines, A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions rest on incremental impact, not campaign output.

• Build a signal-driven system with the Growth Engineer that decides what happens next, starting from a prioritized signal-to-action map.

• Later, build retention and referral programmes and help hire a second Lifecycle Manager.

title: Senior Data Analyst

Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

title: Campaign Analyst
description:
Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie.

  • Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.
